_note: ElevenLabs text_to_sound_effects prompts. Mix every sound 12-26 dB under the VO and vary pitch per use. The typo_* pack maps to text entrances (see kit.js typoCue).

whoosh_short.text: Fast short air whoosh swipe past the microphone, clean, dry, no reverb, no music

whoosh_whip.text: Heavy fast camera whip pan whoosh, aggressive swish transition, dry

impact_slam.text: Punchy cinematic trailer hit, deep sub bass boom with a sharp transient crack, short tail, no music

glitch.text: Digital glitch stutter, data corruption burst, short electronic zap and crackle

shimmer_whiteout.text: Bright magical shimmer swell rising into an airy white flash, reverse cymbal, sparkles

card_flutter.text: Stack of glossy cards fanning out fast, paper flutter swoosh

typing.text: Fast mechanical keyboard typing, crisp clicky keys, close and dry

riser.text: Short tense synth riser building upward into a hit, modern trailer, no drums

thunder.text: Close lightning strike crack followed by deep rolling thunder boom

pixel_burst.text: Retro 8-bit pixel explosion sparkle burst, chiptune particles scattering, short

mosaic_crunch.text: Digital pixel dissolve transition, bitcrushed crunchy glitch sweep, short

ui_pop.text: Soft bubbly UI pop click, very short, clean

typo_whoosh_soft.text: Very soft short airy whoosh for text sliding into frame, subtle, clean, close mic, no reverb

typo_swoosh_up.text: Quick upward swoosh ending in a tiny sparkle, subtle UI text animation sound

typo_fly_in.text: Fast smooth air swish flying toward the camera, short, clean, no reverb

typo_pop_bubble.text: Soft bubbly pop, cute UI text pop-in sound, short and clean

typo_pop_pluck.text: Short plucky marimba pop, playful text appear sound, single note

typo_tick_glass.text: BANNED (Ikhsan 2026-11-02, no ting ting): do not generate or use

typo_card_flick.text: Quick crisp card flick flip, paper snap, short

typo_drop_thud.text: Small soft muted thud of a light object landing, short, dry

typo_swish_swing.text: Short playful whip swish with a slight wobble, light and airy

typo_glitch_chirp.text: Short digital chirp glitch, quick retro computer data blips

typo_decode_scramble.text: Rapid digital scrambling beeps resolving into one clean confirmation tone, short

typo_marker_swipe.text: Quick highlighter marker swipe stroke on paper, short

typo_key_clicks.text: Three fast soft mechanical keyboard key clicks, close and dry

typo_stamp_hit.text: Punchy small stamp hit with a short low thump, text slam UI sound, no reverb tail
